name: Eric Melloul
current_role: Chairman of the Board, Oatly Group AB; independent lead director, The Vita Coco Company; Senior Advisor (ex-Managing Director), Verlinvest
profile: Consumer-goods investor who spent 2008-2024 as a Managing Director of Verlinvest, the Brussels-based de Mevius family investment firm, where he backed Vita Coco (board since ~2008-2010) and Oatly (board since Nov 2016; now chairman). Earlier at AB InBev and McKinsey. SEC-reported holdings relate to these board/insider positions.

deep_cut_fact: Before private equity he was Global Marketing VP and China Commercial Head at Anheuser-Busch InBev (2003-2008), and before that an Associate Partner at McKinsey & Company (1999-2003).
notes: Company bios differ on Verlinvest dates (Vita Coco page: MD Aug 2008-Feb 2024, now Senior Advisor; Oatly page: Senior Advisor Mar 2024-Jun 2025). Best route likely via Oatly/Vita Coco IR or Verlinvest. Investor bio pages blocked automated fetch; facts taken from search extracts of them.

name: Liang Chen
current_role: Chairman, Jiangsu Hichain Logistics Co., Ltd. (Hichain, 300873.SZ)
profile: Liang Chen (梁晨, b. 1962) founded Hichain Logistics in Wujiang, Suzhou in Aug 2011 and is its controlling shareholder; it listed on Shenzhen ChiNext in 2020 and provides supply-chain logistics, logistics equipment and warehouse automation for consumer-electronics, EV, semiconductor and other manufacturers. She signs the 2024 ESG report as chairman.
interesting_fact: Her career started in finance, not logistics: she was an accountant at Guangdong Weiguo Machinery Factory (1980-89) and worked at China Construction Bank Wujiang branch (1989-99) before running trading and logistics firms.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Hichain she was general manager of Haichen Trading (1999-2003) and then of Hengtong Haichen (2003-2011), the predecessor logistics business, per the IPO prospectus.
notes: Female founder (prospectus: 梁晨女士). Hurun co-listing Yang Xi is a fellow Hichain director/vice GM. IR email is the securities department contact published in the 2024 ESG report.

name: Mao Chen
current_role: Chairman, CEO and Executive Director, Viva Biotech Holdings (1873.HK)
profile: Dr. Mao Chen (Cheney), 64, is a structural biologist who joined Viva Biotech in Aug 2008 and has led the Shanghai-based, HK-listed drug discovery CRO group as chairman and CEO since July 2018. He also chairs Viva Shanghai and is a director of Langhua Pharmaceutical entities. Fudan BSc/MSc, Cornell PhD in biochemistry.
interesting_fact: Before industry he was a lecturer and assistant researcher at the Shanghai Institute of Organic Chemistry (CAS) in 1986-90, then did postdocs at Cornell and Duke; he has published about 45 research papers on structure-based drug design.
deep_cut_fact: Before Viva he was a co-founder and VP of Medicilon Inc./Shanghai Medicilon (2003-08), ran the structural biology department at Parker Hughes Institute (1997-2003), and reviewed AIDS structural-biology grants for an NIH review panel (2002-03).
notes: Hurun lists him with Zhou Min. info@ is the company's published shareholder-enquiry address for the Board (2025 annual report).

name: Meng Xin
current_role: Co-actual controller (with husband Pan Jiangen) of Hangzhou Everfine Photo-E-Info Co. (300306.SZ, now short name 远方信息); current executive title not confirmed
profile: 孟欣 (b. 1966) and her husband Pan Jiangen controlled about 81.5% of Everfine, a Hangzhou maker of photometric/optical testing instruments, at its 2012 ChiNext IPO; Pan remains chairman, GM and chief scientist. She co-founded the predecessor Hangzhou Yuanfang Instruments in 1994 and was GM of Mimi Electronics from 2010.
interesting_fact: She trained as a doctor: from 1989 to 1995 she was a physician/attending physician at the Children's Hospital of Zhejiang Medical University, then an attending physician at Zhejiang University's hospital (1995-2002), before joining Everfine in 2003.
deep_cut_fact: In Oct 1994 she was one of four founders of Hangzhou Yuanfang Instruments (registered capital RMB 500,000), putting in RMB 50,000 cash for a 10% stake; that firm became the root of Everfine.
notes: Low public profile; facts are from the 2012 IPO prospectus. Pan Jiangen chairs board meetings per 2024-2026 announcements. Route would be via Everfine company secretary.

name: Olivia Harrison
current_role: Director, Apple Corps; trustee/director, The Material World Foundation; chair, Harrison Family Foundation; steward of George Harrison's estate and catalogue
profile: Born Olivia Trinidad Arias in Los Angeles in 1948, she worked at A&M Records and then George Harrison's Dark Horse label before marrying him in 1978. Since his 2001 death she has managed his legacy: reissues, books and films, and serves as one of Apple Corps' five directors. Her wealth (shared with son Dhani on the Sunday Times list) is inherited.
interesting_fact: She has won Emmys as a producer for Scorsese's 'George Harrison: Living in the Material World' (2011) and 'The Beatles: Get Back' (2021), plus Grammys for 'Concert for George' and the 'All Things Must Pass' reissue.
deep_cut_fact: In 1990 she founded the Romanian Angel Appeal for Romanian orphans, and in 2022 published 'Came the Lightening', a poetic memoir she said was inspired by Edna St. Vincent Millay.
notes: Not an energy/data-center figure; wealth is inherited (George Harrison estate). Best route is via the Material World Foundation email or the George Harrison official site/label. Trustee listing: https://register-of-charities.charitycommission.gov.uk/en/charity-search/-/charity-details/266746/trustees
